title: 헌법재판소 정보화심의위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Organization of Working-Level Council)
(1) A working-level council may be established within the Committee to prepare and conduct prior review of agenda items to be submitted to the Committee and to handle practical matters concerning informatization affairs. <Amended on March 22, 2021>
(2) The chairperson and members of the working-level council shall be designated by the Chairperson from among employees of the Constitutional Court. <Amended on April 27, 2015; December 24, 2020; March 22, 2021>
(3) The working-level council shall report the results of its meetings to the Chairperson. <Amended on April 27, 2015>
(4) Matters concerning the operation of the working-level council shall be governed mutatis mutandis by the relevant provisions concerning the Committee. <Amended on April 27, 2015>
